European Speed Dating Vaughan (Ages 35-48) 

 
 Looking to meet other singles who share your cultural background and similar outlook on life? 
 

 Join us for an evening of great conversation and genuine connection at our European Speed Dating event. Whether you have European roots, grew up immersed in European culture, or simply feel a strong connection to it, this event is for you.
 Connect with others who appreciate shared values, traditions, and experiences.
 All races and backgrounds with a focus on European heritage are welcome.
 Bring a Friend, Save Together: Book with a friend and enjoy an exclusive 15% discount on your tickets, automatically applied at checkout!
 

 Inclusions: 
 Up to 15 Dates Appetizers 

 Sign in Begins at 7:15pm / Dating at 7:30pm
 

 Upon arrival, simply check in with our friendly host. We utilize a digital platform to streamline the process of selecting matches and initiating conversations afterward, making the experience more efficient for you. If you haven’t used our platform before, no worries! You’ll receive an email on the day of the event to create your profile. Rest assured, this app doesn’t require downloading to your phone. In case you haven’t received an email or sign up late, don’t panic! Our host will ensure you’re added upon arrival. Please remember to charge your phone to fully enjoy the experience.
 Don’t miss out on this opportunity to expand your social circle and meet single professionals in your city. Book your spot today and get ready for an unforgettable night of mingling, meshing, and making meaningful connections!
 

 Important Items to Note: 
 

 * Cancellations must be made 5 business days before the event for a credit. No refunds or credits will be issued for illness or last-minute cancellations, but tickets can be transferred to another person for the same event. A 2.9% + $0.30 processing fee applies for cancellations due to credit card transaction fees.
 * If the event is cancelled by us, you may choose a full refund or credit. For weather-related cancellations, no refund will be issued, but a credit will be applied to a future event.
 * Matches will be sent by 9 AM the following business day, with notifications sent via email/phone. Personal information like last names, emails, or phone numbers will not be exchanged through the platform.
 * A 2-3 year flexibility is allowed for the age range.
 * Please arrive on time. Late arrivals (15+ minutes) may forfeit their spot, with no refund or credit.
 * To ensure receipt of event confirmations, please add @singleinthecity.ca to your safe list to avoid email issues.

body:
MedTech, HealthTech Startups, Investors, Innovators Networking Event 
 
 Toronto HealthTech Connect: a night of networking with Health and MedTech startups, investors, entrepreneurs, and professionals

 About this Event 

 
Join the vibrant community of health tech startups, entrepreneurs, and professionals at HealthTech Connect. This premier networking event is dedicated to fostering connections and collaborations among those passionate about revolutionizing healthcare through technology.
 Whether you're a budding startup looking to make your mark, an entrepreneur with innovative ideas, or a seasoned professional seeking new opportunities, HealthTech Connect offers the perfect platform to exchange insights, discover cutting-edge advancements, and build meaningful relationships.
 Who Should Attend? 
 Health Tech Startups: If you're an emerging health tech company looking to make a mark, this event is the perfect opportunity to network with potential partners, investors, and clients. Share your innovative ideas and discover new pathways for growth.
 Entrepreneurs: Those with a vision for transforming healthcare through technology will find valuable connections and insights at HealthTech Connect. Meet like-minded entrepreneurs, share your experiences, and collaborate on groundbreaking projects.
 Healthcare Professionals: Doctors, nurses, and other healthcare providers interested in integrating technology into their practices can benefit from the latest innovations and network with tech developers who understand the needs of the healthcare industry.
 Investors: Venture capitalists and angel investors looking for the next big thing in health tech will have the chance to meet promising startups and entrepreneurs. Discover investment opportunities and stay informed about cutting-edge developments.
 Tech Enthusiasts and Innovators: Anyone passionate about the intersection of technology and healthcare is welcome. Engage in thought-provoking conversations, learn from others in the field, and contribute your ideas to the health tech community.
 Policy Makers and Industry Leaders: Individuals involved in shaping healthcare policy and leading industry organizations can gain insights into emerging trends and connect with innovators driving the future of health technology.
 The event focuses on dynamic networking sessions and engaging speed presentations. These concise, impactful presentations allow participants to quickly share their innovations and ideas with the entire audience, fostering an environment of rapid learning and connection.
 Why Attend? 
 Expand Your Network: Connect with like-minded individuals who share a passion for health technology. Build relationships with potential partners, collaborators, and mentors who can help you grow your business and advance your career.
 Speed Presentations: Engage in dynamic speed presentations where participants share innovative ideas and solutions. Gain quick insights into the latest trends and developments in health tech, and find inspiration for your own projects.
 Discover Opportunities: Meet potential investors, partners, and clients. Whether you're looking to fund your startup, collaborate on a project, or expand your professional network, this event provides a unique platform to discover new opportunities.
 Stay Ahead of the Curve: Keep up-to-date with the latest advancements and emerging trends in health technology. Learn from your peers and stay informed about the innovations that are shaping the future of healthcare.
 Be Part of a Community: Join a dynamic community of health tech innovators who are dedicated to making a difference in healthcare. Share your experiences, challenges, and successes with others who understand your journey.
 

 Guest Guidelines: 
 Guests must be 21+ years old Please arrive well-presented Purchase one drink at the bar (alcohol-free options included) You will be able to join the dedicated Whatsapp group for the event and start networking before the actual event. 
 

 HealthTech Connect is not just about networking; it's about being part of a dynamic community that is shaping the future of health technology. Don’t miss this chance to be at the forefront of healthcare innovation. Come and join us for an event that promises to ignite ideas and foster growth in the health tech sector.
 

 Register now to secure your spot and be part of this transformative networking experience.
 

 How our event works:
 You are invited to join the dedicated Whatsapp group for the event and start networking before the actual event.
 This event will be hosted till 9pm; the key to making the most of speed friending is to follow up with your contacts over time to develop friendships.
 Dress code is either business or office attire or smart casual, no T-shirts, no trainers.

50th Anniversary Banquet 
 
 

 About this Event 

 Tyndale invites you to a commemorative evening celebrating 50 years of Tyndale Seminary — many stories of influence, sacrifice, and faithful ministry united by one mission: serving the Church and the world for the glory of God.
 What began in 1976 as Ontario Theological Seminary built upon the foundation first laid in 1894 through the Toronto Bible Training School. From the beginning, the vision was clear: to provide biblically centered, people-related, and experience-oriented theological education that equips men and women for faithful Gospel ministry in a changing world.
 Fifty years later, that mission continues. Tyndale Seminary has become a place where students from diverse backgrounds, nations, and traditions are formed for Gospel impact across Canada and around the world.
 Join alumni, students, faculty, staff, supporters, and friends of the Seminary for an elegant evening of dinner, worship, reflection, stories of impact, and celebration with the greater Tyndale community. Together, we will give thanks for God’s faithfulness through generations and celebrate the one mission that continues to guide us.

Paint a Patagonia Volcano with Watercolour Brush Pens at Staples Store 155 
 
 Create a colourful volcano landscape inspired by Patagonia's mountains while learning fun, beginner-friendly watercolour techniques.

 About this Event 

 Travel to the mountains of Patagonia! In this hands-on workshop, tweens will create a vibrant watercolour landscape inspired by South America's dramatic peaks and crystal-blue lakes. Using watercolour brush pens, students will learn easy techniques for blending colours, creating depth, and painting an exciting erupting volcano. Step by step, they'll transform simple shapes into a bold work of art filled with colourful wildflowers, mountain scenery, and volcanic action. No prior watercolour experience is needed—just bring your creativity and get ready for an artistic adventure!
 In this session, kids will: 
 Learn watercolour brush pen basics including blending and layering. Create realistic landscape elements such as mountains, water, clouds, and flowers. Paint an exciting erupting volcano using simple techniques and dramatic colour effects. Build confidence in artistic skills through easy-to-follow, step-by-step instruction. Take home a finished Patagonia-inspired masterpiece that showcases creativity and imagination. Supplies provided for the event: 
 STAEDTLER Watercolour brush pens, pack of 6 colours STAEDTLER Lumograph pencil to transfer drawing Heavy watercolour paper, 9 x 12 Plastic palette or white plastic plate Paint brush or water brush Water cup and paper towel Tutorial handout – includes drawing template The event runs from 5:00 PM to 7:00 PM, with each child enjoying a 30-minute building session.

 All supplies will be provided.

body:
Unionville Adventure Hangout - YorkU Markham Campus 
 
 Meet your future classmates, explore the beautiful Unionville area, and make memories before the semester begins

 About this Event 

 Starting university is exciting—but it can also feel a little overwhelming. Why not meet your future classmates before classes even begin?
 Join us for Unionville Adventure Hangout , a fun day designed exclusively for incoming York University Markham students.
 Together, we'll explore the charming streets of Maint St. Unionville, take part in interactive team activities, enjoy a delicious lunch and picnic, play outdoor games, and discover one of Markham's most beautiful neighborhoods.
 Whether you're coming with friends or attending on your own, this event is the perfect opportunity to make new connections, chat with current students, ask questions about university life, meet with peer mentors, who are upper year students in your program who can answer all your university questions and start building your York community before your first day of class.
 All attendees will be required to sign and return a permission form in order to particpate at the event. This form will be emailed to all attendees prior to event. Please note that any student under the age of 18 will require permssion from their caregiver/guardian.

body:
The Plummet Summit - An Un-Conference for Artists and Path-makers 
 
 Connecting creatives to dream, collaborate & explore new possibilities in York Region and beyond

 About this Event 

 The Plummet Summit now in Year 2, invites participants to embrace the fall. Every fall is a step towards growth. Through collaborative creation and wellness modules, participants will explore Shadowpath opportunities as apprentices, performers, volunteers, audience members or imagine bold new ways to contribute to our movement for holistic, cultural change.
 Hosted at the Varley Art Gallery in Unionville, this un-conference catalyzes new paths for a more creative York Region.
 1:00 PM – The Plummet 
 🌀 Welcome - A Mosaic of Failure to Return Stronger 
 Join us in collective collage-making and web weaving. Reflect on failure as a necessary pathway to resilience, longevity and being unstoppable.
 Let’s also talk: New mental health resources for artists ! Be a part of our focus group!
 ⚡ Part of falling forward is showing up. Throughout, you'll witness brave bursts of performance from artists auditioning in real time.
 2:15 PM – Refresh | Tea, Chat + Art 
 2:30 PM – The Anti-AGM (A Gathering of Minds) 
 💸 Shadowpath Math: How much do we pay artists? How do we talk about money AND art?
 🎭 Rapid-fire Update: What’s Shadowpath been up to lately?
 🎉 Opportunities Unveiled: Apprentice roles, performer calls, volunteer pathways
 🌈 Collective Dreaming: What’s next for our artist community?
 🌟 2:45 PM - Artist of the Year 2026 Announcement!
 Most Cultural Municipality of York Region Announcement!
 The Past and Future Path of Shadows Revealed.
 3:00 PM 🧘 Speakers TBA, Coming Soon. 
 

 Pay-What-You-Can - note, donations of $20+ will receive a charitable tax receipt.
